children.name: Azima angustifolia A.DC.
children.description: The native range of this species is Madagascar. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Azima tetracantha Lam.
children.description: Shrub, on coastal slopes and mangrove edge. C. N.: mussaca-zumbi (kb). Uses: medicinal.

children.name: Dobera loranthifolia Warb. ex Harms
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Somalia to NE. Mozambique. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Salvadora alii Rajput & Tahir
children.description: The native range of this species is Pakistan to C. India. It is a scrambling shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Salvadora angustifolia Turrill
children.description: The native range of this species is Juan de Nova I, Aldabra (Cosmoledo), Madagascar. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Salvadora australis Schweick.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Trop. & S. Africa. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Salvadora oleoides Decne.
children.description: Salvadora oleoides is a small bushy evergreen tree found in India and Pakistan and southern Iran.[https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:779346-1] Its common name is Vann or (Large) Toothbrush Tree.

children.name: Salvadora persica L.
children.description: Salvadora persica or the arak, Its roots and twigs called miswak are traditionally used for chewing as a toothbrush.
